patreon_help_advanced_commands_list:
`patreon sync` - Sync supporter data van API
`patreon supporters` - List active supporters
`patreon link` - Link Discord Gebruiker naar Patreon

`patreon tiermap` - Map tier naar Discord Rol
`patreon syncall` - Sync allemaal supporter Rollen

`patreon announce` - Send manual announcement
